d:
Dipavli ke pavan parv par rashtriy janta dal (RJD) neta aur bihar ke purv upmukhyamantri tejasvi yadav ne samast deshvasiyon aur bihar vasiyon ko dipavli ki hardik shubhkamnaen di hain.
Tejasvi yadav ne apne vishesh divali sandesh men yuvaon aur Gen-Z (naee pirhi) ko kendr men rakhte hue ek bara samajik aur rajnitik sandesh diya. unhonne kaha, "is divali sirph mitti ka diya hi nahin, balki apne sunahre sapnon, aasha aur ummidon se sarabor kirnon ke sath shanti-samriddhi, umang-unnati, aanand-khushhali aur badlav ka bhi dip jalana hai."
